test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 3 Feb 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: The main aim of the 'Ganga Action Plan’ is:

options.text: Efficient use of Ganga water for drinking purpose
Reduction of pollution in Ganga river
Efficient use of Ganga water for irrigation
Using Ganga river for generating hydel energy

solution:
Correct answer is __**Reduction of pollution in Ganga river.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Its main motive was **to protect the river from the hazards of pollution**.
 
• 'Ganga Action Plan’ aims at** improving the quality of its water and preventing further pollution.**
 
• It acts by preventing industrial waste from being dumped into the waters.
 
• The Ganga Action plan was started in India on **14th January 1986 by Rajiv Gandhi.**
 
• [IMAGE: https://encrypted-tbn0.gstatic.com/images?q=tbn:ANd9GcQYZAe7xN8SXl3Uj96PKv2HafeHdSSjEIkyUQ&usqp=CAU] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ​Ganga action plan was **started in 1986 with the objective of pollution abatement from river Ganga**. 
 
• Ganga Action Plan is a **100% centrally sponsored scheme. ** 
 
• Under this plan, the National River Ganga basin authority was** began and announced Ganga as a national river of India.**
